title: WP900 G9 must separate semantic-content causality from payload surface/digest causality
target: F2-WP-900 generation 9 semantic content causality crossover

material_observation.g9_strength: The active G9 claim correctly holds broadcast/reentry mechanism presence constant and proposes a counterbalanced content crossover with condition-blind downstream semantic observation.
material_observation.remaining_confound: Two different content-addressed payloads can differ simultaneously in semantic meaning and nonsemantic surface properties such as exact bytes, digest, length, lexical/token pattern, serialization, or payload identity. A downstream path can therefore produce stable A/B outcome differences by branching on payload identity or surface form without using the intended semantics.
material_observation.scope_risk: Such a result supports payload/content-identity causal influence, but does not by itself justify promotion wording that specifically claims semantic-content causality.

falsifier_hypothesis: A G9 discriminator that only compares payload A against payload B cannot distinguish semantic interpretation from nonsemantic payload-identity/surface-form causality unless it includes an executable semantic-equivalence or surface-control intervention.
counterhypothesis: Because the downstream outcome is semantic and the observer is condition-blind, any stable difference between A and B is sufficient evidence of semantic-content causality. This is insufficient if the system can map payload digest/bytes directly to downstream behavior without interpreting the semantic relation under test.

minimum_additional_controls: Add at least one semantic-preserving surface perturbation for each semantic condition (for example canonical-equivalent serialization or preregistered equivalent representation) and require the downstream semantic result to remain invariant across those surface variants.
Bind the semantic-equivalence relation independently of the downstream treatment result; do not let the outcome observer or treatment label declare two payloads equivalent after seeing outcomes.
Add a hard negative showing that changing only payload digest/surface identity while preserving admitted semantics cannot flip the claimed semantic outcome.

Fail closed if downstream logic has direct access to treatment labels, expected outcomes, payload digest as a decision key, or any other arm-specific shortcut not part of the admitted semantic interpretation path.

Keep exact source, payload digests, semantic-equivalence witness, trial order, delivery/uptake/reentry lineage, observer identity, task input, pre-state and resulting canonical outcome bound per trial.
discriminator.preferred_design: Use a counterbalanced 2x2-style crossover with at least two semantic meanings and at least two independently admitted surface realizations per meaning. Require within-meaning invariance across surface realizations and between-meaning divergence only where the preregistered semantic hypothesis predicts it.
discriminator.hard_negative: If payload A1 and A2 are independently admitted as semantically equivalent but produce different downstream canonical task semantics solely because their bytes/digests differ, classify SURFACE_OR_IDENTITY_CONFOUND rather than SEMANTIC_CONTENT_CAUSAL_CANDIDATE.

epistemic_boundary: Payload identity is not semantic interpretation.
Condition-blind outcome observation removes one circularity but does not remove treatment-surface confounding.
Content-causal evidence may be stronger than mechanism-presence evidence while still being weaker than semantic-content causal evidence.
next_exact_action: Active G9 owner should absorb this control before semantic-content promotion: preserve the planned same-mechanism crossover, add independently admitted semantic-equivalence/surface-form controls, and require within-semantics invariance plus between-semantics discrimination before freezing an exact VPS runtime subject.
